div.head: Attachment
div.p: DRAFT RESOLUTION ON WEST NEW GUINEA
Recognizing that the territory of West New Guinea has been the subject of dispute between Indonesia and the Netherlands;
Considering that the future status of the territory should be determined by its people in accordance with this principle;
Recognizing further the need for a full and impartial report regarding the territory;

list.item: Establishes a Commission composed of (three to five countries);
Requests the Commission to report to the General Assembly at its Seventeenth Session;
Requests the Secretary General to make available to the Commission the necessary staff and administrative facilities.
